reply_text:
I replied to Marcus in his DM: keep Tuesday 10 November at 10:15 free for the Driftwood call.

That time comes from what he told me in that same DM on 14 October: his standing Tamsin Cold Chain / Driftwood call moved to Tuesdays at 10:15. I didn't see anything in #north-team that changes it. The call isn't on his calendar for 9–13 November, so I suggested he add it.

I didn't use the other members' standing call times I have in memory. Those came from their own private DMs.
